messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] P2 - elevated queue depth on dedicated-pool-eu-west-3. Trigger: queue depth > 80% for 3m. Observed latency spike (~800ms) and ~4% token drops. Keys implicated: acme-prod-01.

alex-oncall: i'm paged, looking now. pulling recent autoscale events and pool metrics.

maria-ml: saw a sudden traffic spike from AcmeCorp's tenant keys ~23:09 UTC. pattern looks like a large batch import hitting the inference endpoint.

sam-infra: checking node health. GPUs at 96-99% on pool dedicated-eu-west-3, memory pressure on two hosts.

jamie-support: customer reported failures beginning ~23:10 UTC, marked as "degraded" in ticket #4527. letting them know we're investigating.

alex-oncall: quick mitigation proposal: 1) apply tenant-level protective rate limit to acme-prod-01 at 120rps 2) enable short burst autoscale profile (aggressive, +2 nodes, 10m) 3) activate traffic shaping to favor critical routes. objections?

maria-ml: +1 to throttling and short aggressive autoscale. KV-cache warmup risk but better than full outages.

sam-infra: i can flip the autoscale profile now. running infra toggle: 
```
/infra toggle-autoscale --pool dedicated-eu-west-3 --profile aggressive-short --extra-nodes 2 --duration 10m --reason "surge: acme-prod"
```

sam-infra: executed. autoscale event id=96823. new nodes enrolling (3m ETA).

alex-oncall: applying tenant rate cap: 
```
/admin set-rate-limit --tenant acme-prod-01 --limit 120rps --scope global --ttl 10m --note "protect pool during surge"
```

alex-oncall: rate limit applied. confirm with metrics.

maria-ml: metrics: request rate from tenant now capped, overall queue depth starting to fall (75% -> 52%). p95 latency trending down.

jamie-support: messaged customer: "We've temporarily throttled your traffic and enabled additional capacity; this should reduce errors while we stabilize. We'll keep you updated." customer replied: "okay, thanks."

rene-ops: ensure auto-revert is set and add an explicit rollback checkpoint. don't want accidental long-lived throttles.

sam-infra: auto-revert=true on the autoscale toggle; added meta tag rollback_at=+10m. also created alert to notify if queue depth doesn't drop below 40% within 12m.

alex-oncall: handing off monitoring to @maria-ml for the next 15m. i'll update runbook with actions taken. statuspage patched (incident: degraded for dedicated-eu-west-3).

maria-ml: taking watch. if error-rate doesn't return to baseline after nodes join, escalate to dedicated-sre and consider temporary customer circuit-break (hard deny) for the offending key.

jamie-support: customer confirms success rate improved 23:14 UTC: 45%->97% on recent checks.

sam-infra: new nodes registered; node util back to ~60-70%. KV cache warmups ongoing but hit-rate improving. autoscale event will auto-revert at 10m.

alex-oncall: good. leaving notes: actions = {rate-limit 120rps tenant=acme-prod-01, autoscale aggressive-short +2 nodes duration 10m, statuspage updated, customer notified}. handoff complete.

incident-bot: annotation added: autoscale_event=96823, rate_limit_change=rl-5538, ticket=4527.

maria-ml: monitoring continues; will post final close when metric window stable.

jamie-support: closing customer loop in ticket after final confirmation.

alex-oncall: thanks all — if anything regresses ping here or page.

maria-ml: final check 23:22 UTC: queue depth 28%, p95 latency back to baseline. marking incident resolved, will file a short postmortem with suggested mitigations (tenant throttles per-policy, improved early-detection for burst imports).

incident-bot: incident state -> resolved (resolved_by: maria-ml, duration: 8m).
